about: NAME-ONLY mirror of the terms the other HQ owns. Definitions are deliberately absent and must never be added here: one term, one owner, one definition, one file. This file exists so the gate can reject a redefinition of a foreign term without importing another repo's source (Federation Invariant 1 - vendor small pure pieces, never import). To extend one of these terms, edit it in gaia-research's founder/lexicon.<namespace>.json and update this mirror in the same PR cycle. 2026-08-11 (Skill Zero rename): gaia.heaven was split - the LAUNCHER vocabulary is carved out into the new gaia.zero namespace (still owned by the gaia-research HQ), while gaia.heaven keeps the umbrella + Arbor axis vocabulary (heaven/hell/ultra as summon directions + governor). The retired door product names (claude-heaven, pi-heaven, hh-launcher, skill-heaven-hell) are dropped in favour of the *-zero names. NOTE: gaia.zero is owned authoritatively by the gaia-research HQ and mirrored name-only here; both sides of the carve-out have landed, so reconcile any future mismatch by updating this mirror to match the source of truth.
